sources.anchor: A program descriptor is executable authority

assumptions: Generated hosts are entered through registered ___call/___run and legitimate tail/trampoline transfer; arbitrary forged private HOST pointers are not an admitted FFI API.
The existing cooperative collective parks owners between source freeze and final restore barrier; no asynchronous context migration is added.
VM lifetime is retained by existing entry/root/native debts; unknown retirement never authorizes reclamation.
Setup caller owns the sole CLAIMED fixup activation; an abnormal unknown exit leaves it non-executable and does not authorize a helper to repeat writes.
argument: Ordinary lookup uses the same global_page and stable canonical cells as the original resolver. Native VM identity equals the admitted PSTATE VM and does not move with Scheme GC.

For primitive reads, old cell and flag helpers may acquire different directory generations, but directory growth preserves canonical page addresses. The new single lookup selects the same cell, presence and value ordering. PRMCELL already acquires the template.
Public raw native reads/writes retain root_writer_open. Generated host authorization is consumed from existing entry/RootTask lifetime rather than a duplicate per-host permit.

Root/context prefix layout is unchanged; appended VM identity is a native pointer, not a Scheme root. Frozen scanning and multi-shot frame layout are unchanged; actual306 fixture/290 layout and102 C checks pass.
Last leave clears the identity while the final entry retains context. Collective refresh follows RC reopening and precedes the existing second BARRIER. Unknown cleanup retains the VM.
Fixup claim/completion serialize under global_gate; executable descriptor collection acquires READY. The ABI prefix check rejects old layouts before reading the added state.
notClaimed: No machine-checked C memory-model proof. TLC proves only the finite fixup protocol; existing entry/unload QNT and Lean laws retain their distinct roles.
No whole default-SMP, current full Gerbil rebuild, live cross-VM context migration, CFFI completion or universal performance qualification.
Default frontend/frame failures remain failures in both roles, with differing signals; equivalent p1 source/native consumers are the admitted compiler context.
